name: vibedev_rail_reply_start_failed
content: Nothing was left running — any task created for this attempt has been removed, so retrying `@vibedev` will not produce a duplicate.

metadata.description: Assistant reply when a `@vibedev` chat turn failed to create or dispatch its run. Create+dispatch is atomic for the rail: a dispatch failure removes the just-created task before this reply, so the promise made here is the behaviour the caller implements.
metadata.author: magician
